page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Printed page number 60 at the head; running head DESCRIPTIO. Show-through and red scan-edge marks at the left edge are not transcribed.

main_text.p: hac in regione transferte, modò non intra lxxx, id est, x pass. millia à mari: hanc enim diruere nobis constitutum. Quibus auditis, clamor consternatorum & dolentium Pœnorum penè insanus in cœlum sublatus: mox eorundem secutum mœstum silentium velut mortuorum in terram concidentium; & paulò pòst rursum lamenta & acerbę querelæ; iterumque profundum silentium reputantium infelicem conditionem suam, & præ magnitudine malorum stupescentium, ut ipsos Romanos præsentes commiseratione commoverent. Postremò Pœnorum illustrissimus, & sermone promptissimus ad se rever-sus, accepta dicendi copiâ, oratione ad rem accommodâ & verè pathetica ad misericordiam flectere Consulum animos, & extrema illa deprecari conatus fuit, nemesinque infestam felicibus fortuna sua in injuriam & contumeliam infelicium abutentibus, memorare est aufus: verum actum egit. Nam Consul idem præsentes rursum affatus, non esse dixit sui collegæque arbitrii, decretum senatus populique mutare, aut ab eo discedere: suadere, ut ferant moderatè, quod ferre necesse esset: persuadere quoque conatus, utile futurum rebus forum, à mari recedere: maritimam sedem

page.notes: Left margin at the foot shows small fragments ("ri re", "ri rcgoi", "ri regoi itri") that appear to be show-through from the reverse side, so they are left out. Possible printing errors kept as printed: "transferte" (for transferre), "pass." abbreviation. The line break after "commove" and "rever-" is marked with a printed hyphen as far as it can be seen; "commove-rent" is a doubtful join. "forum" at the start of the line after "rebus" is read as printed and may be a split word.
